data.name: Conjuration Opposition School
data.description: You have chosen conjuration spells as an opposition school. Preparing an conjuration spell takes up two spell slots of the same level. You take a -4 penalty on any skill checks made when crafting a magic item that has an conjuration spell as a prerequisite.
